title: Questions 186-190 refer to the following e-mail, product guide, and customer review.
passage_1:
To:Field Engineering Staff
From:Naledi Mokoena <n.mokoena@kestrelutilities.com>
Date:6 June
Subject:Tool Reimbursement

Dear Team,

To make sure that you can work comfortably and safely on site, Kestrel Utilities will reimburse part of the cost of upgrading your personal tool kit. All permanent engineers who have been with the company for more than two years may claim up to £350 under this new program to purchase low-vibration hand tools, such as insulated pliers or torque drivers. To claim, please send your receipt and a photograph of the tool in use by 31 July.

You are free to buy from any supplier, but we suggest Ridgeway Tool Works, which offers well-made selections of equipment at reasonable prices. Its Eastgate branch is only three blocks from our warehouse, so it is easy to try things out.

Best regards,

Naledi Mokoena
Personnel Director

SUMMER TOOL GUIDE — Ridgeway Tool Works

Below are our featured selections for the season.

  • Torque Drivers: our Vantage series drivers are our best sellers. Every Vantage driver comes with a free calibration certificate.
  • Insulated Pliers: available with straight or bent jaws. All pliers carry a full five-year guarantee.
  • Cable Cutters: light cutters that reduce wrist strain. Buy one now and receive a free blade oil pen.
  • Head Torches: rechargeable torches for confined spaces. Includes a complimentary spare battery.

You are welcome to visit our Eastgate, Northgate, and Riverside branches to speak to our specialists. We also offer free delivery on all orders over £500.

CUSTOMER REVIEW

Product: Vantage Torque Driver
By: Petar Ilić
Date: 20 June
Rating: ★★★★★

When my company offered to cover the new tools for field staff, I was delighted. I called in at the Ridgeway branch on Eastgate yesterday because it is so near our warehouse. The sales assistant had extensive product knowledge and guided me in choosing the appropriate items.

I eventually purchased a Vantage torque driver. The action is smooth, the grip stays comfortable even after a long shift, and it is already earning its keep on site. I think this product is definitely worth recommending!
